Could rain have caused this?: We couldn't check the rainfall for this place, so we can't say yet.
How sure can we be?: Reasonably sure. We could not compare the new water with another satellite's water map, so this cannot be High.
What could be wrong?: These are estimates. Very wet fields can sometimes look like water. Some spots, like steep hillsides, can't be seen clearly and are left out. Some NISAR data used is Provisional quality; numbers may change when reprocessed. Land cover (ESA WorldCover) was not checked, so we cannot say whether new water lies on cropland. This place and these dates have not been compared with OPERA: the method was compared on one lake window (Jul to Oct 2026, track 83) only.
Did the water go down anywhere?: No, not in any noticeable way. The water only spread between these dates.
